overloads.semanticRole: Returns a constant code for the type of the designated form object in the current form (or the last object, if several are designated).

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference. Passing '*' is mandatory when designating static objects such as lines or rectangles, since those have no variable/field reference form.
